title: XtraLight-MedMamba for Classification of Neoplastic Tubular Adenomas
abstract: arXiv:2602.04819v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate risk stratification of precancerous polyps during routine colonoscopy screening is a key strategy to reduce the incidence of colorectal cancer (CRC). However, assessment of low-grade dysplasia remains limited by subjective histopathologic interpretation. Advances in computational pathology and deep learning offer new opportunities to identify subtle, fine morphologic patterns associated with malignant progression that may be imperceptible to the human eye. In this work, we propose XtraLight-MedMamba, an ultra-lightweight state-space-based deep learning framework to classify neoplastic tubular adenomas from whole-slide images (WSIs). The architecture is a blend of a ConvNeXt-based shallow feature extractor with parallel vision mamba blocks to efficiently model local texture cues within global contextual structure. translated_title: XtraLight-MedMamba用于肿瘤性管状腺瘤的分类
translated_abstract: 摘要：在常规结肠镜筛查中，对癌前息肉进行准确的风险分层是降低结直肠癌（CRC）发病率的关键策略。然而，低级别发育不良的评估仍受限于主观的组织病理学解释。计算病理学和深度学习的进展为识别与恶性进展相关的、可能人眼难以察觉的细微形态学模式提供了新的机会。在这项工作中，我们提出了XtraLight-MedMamba，一个超轻量级的基于状态空间的深度学习框架，用于从全切片图像（WSIs）中分类肿瘤性管状腺瘤。该架构结合了基于ConvNeXt的浅层特征提取器与并行视觉mamba块，以在全局上下文结构内高效建模局部纹理线索。空间和通道注意力桥接（SCAB）模块的集成增强了多尺度特征提取。
tldr: 本文提出了一种超轻量级的基于状态空间的深度学习框架XtraLight-MedMamba，结合ConvNeXt和视觉mamba块以及注意力模块，用于从全切片图像中高效分类肿瘤性管状腺瘤。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes XtraLight-MedMamba, an ultra-lightweight state-space deep learning framework combining ConvNeXt and vision mamba blocks with attention modules for efficient classification of neoplastic tubular adenomas from whole-slide images.
